producer.responsibility: Собрать изолированные provisional payload, получить authority-backed acquire outcome и передать только FinalizedAnchorAssembly либо один pre-lease abort/failure/termination без прямого wire handoff

capabilities: разрешить нормализованный относительный путь без раскрытия машинного корня
атомарно получить contour, root_id, locator и raw SHA-256 исходных байтов по record_id + state_generation
получить typed acquire outcome от generation coordinator; release lifecycle принадлежит отдельному lease-контракту

inputs.meaning: Итоговая каноническая запись с относительным локатором, полным payload селектора, record identity и content hash; типизированный root в запись не входит
inputs.identity: CanonicalRecord::id; root определяется только отдельным provenance lookup

inputs.meaning: Неизменяемое поколение, захваченное поисковым вызовом до выбора кандидатов и повторно проверенное перед публикацией полного ответа
constraints: equals captured state_generation in IN-RANKED-CANONICAL-BUNDLE before INIT, lookup or lease request

inputs.meaning: Повторно открытый допущенный профиль рабочей области, определяющий workspace_id и множество допустимых contour/root_id, но не выбирающий root записи
inputs.identity: workspace id and rooted source ids

inputs.meaning: Обязательный атомарный lookup при построении ответа по record_id + захваченный state_generation: contour, root_id, относительный locator с полным selector payload и raw SHA-256 исходных байтов либо типизированная причина
inputs.format: SourceAnchorProvenanceLookupOutcome v1 NOT_IMPLEMENTED; lookup выполняется до публикации PublicSearchResult v2
inputs.identity: Идентичность попытки lookup по record_id + state_generation; при успехе также contour + root_id + relative_path + selector + raw_source_sha256

inputs.meaning: Контекст всей explicit-v2 сборки: response_assembly_id, исходный query, captured state_generation и полный упорядоченный набор ожидаемых position_id + record_id
inputs.identity: workspace identity + response_assembly_id + query + captured state_generation + ordered opaque position_id + record_id pairs
constraints: query is the exact query retained for outer response assembly
each position_id is opaque and unique within response_assembly_id
position_id is not rank and is never emitted in public wire
captured state_generation equals IN-SEARCH-GENERATION before per-record work

inputs.meaning: Авторитетная identity локального Windows process, владеющего response assembly и будущим lease
constraints: PID alone is forbidden
identity is captured before acquire request
reused PID with another start time is another owner

inputs.meaning: Авторитетный ответ generation coordinator: ACTIVE_ACQUIRED, REPLAYED_TERMINAL, REPLAYED_PROCESS_DIED, CHANGED либо FAILED
inputs.identity: workspace identity + response_assembly_id + captured state_generation + ACTIVE_ACQUIRED(lease_id, observed, state_revision) | REPLAYED_TERMINAL(lease_id, committed_terminal_identity, terminal_journal_ref, terminal_record_digest, released_revision) | REPLAYED_PROCESS_DIED(lease_id, owner identity, cleanup revision) | CHANGED(observed, state_revision) | FAILED(stage, cause)
inputs.cardinality: 0..1 per OUT-GENERATION-PUBLICATION-LEASE-REQUEST; exactly 1 only when the same coordinator decision has neither commit-recovery status nor state-access block
constraints: response_assembly_id and captured generation exactly equal the request
mutually exclusive with IN-ACQUIRE-GENERATION-LEASE-COMMIT-RECOVERY-STATUS and IN-ACQUIRE-GENERATION-LEASE-STATE-ACCESS-BLOCKED for the same decision
ACTIVE_ACQUIRED iff coordinator proves the exact durable active lease
REPLAYED_TERMINAL preserves lease_id, committed_terminal_identity, terminal_journal_ref, terminal_record_digest and released_revision byte-for-byte from OUT-LEASE-ACQUIRE-OUTCOME
REPLAYED_TERMINAL and REPLAYED_PROCESS_DIED never create a new permit
CHANGED iff observed generation differs and no lease exists
FAILED carries exact stage and cause and creates no lease
active set, replay state and writer admission are authoritative only in BC-FS-GENERATION-PUBLICATION-LEASE

inputs.meaning: Typed control outcome недоказанной записи exact ACQUIRE без usable lease outcome
inputs.identity: workspace identity + operation_kind + operation_identity + proposal revision/digest + NOT_COMMITTED_RETRY(previous_revision) | COMMIT_READBACK_REQUIRED(lookup_attempt_identity + stage + cause + attempt_number + deadline) | COMMIT_RECOVERY_BLOCKED(last_lookup_attempt_identity + stage + cause + evidence_ref)
inputs.cardinality: 0..1 current status per acquire decision; exactly 1 only when the same decision has neither lease domain outcome nor state-access block
constraints: operation_kind is ACQUIRE
complete acquire identity, proposal revision/digest and variant payload are preserved byte-for-byte from OUT-LEASE-COMMIT-RECOVERY-STATUS
a status for an earlier proposal cannot advance or block a later proposal
mutually exclusive with IN-GENERATION-PUBLICATION-LEASE-OUTCOME and IN-ACQUIRE-GENERATION-LEASE-STATE-ACCESS-BLOCKED for the same decision
status never proves lease absence or presence
no status creates permit, finalized assembly, public terminal or release

inputs.meaning: Typed terminal block exact ACQUIRE, когда authoritative generation ledger потерян, повреждён либо недоступен
inputs.identity: workspace identity + operation_kind + operation_identity + lookup attempt identity + optional retained proposal revision/digest + optional lookup revision + MISSING_PREVIOUS|CORRUPT|UNAVAILABLE(stage + cause)
inputs.cardinality: 0..1 per acquire decision; exactly 1 only when the same decision has neither lease domain outcome nor commit-recovery status
constraints: operation_kind is ACQUIRE
complete acquire identity, lookup evidence and optional retained proposal identity are preserved byte-for-byte from OUT-LEASE-STATE-ACCESS-BLOCKED
mutually exclusive with IN-GENERATION-PUBLICATION-LEASE-OUTCOME and IN-ACQUIRE-GENERATION-LEASE-COMMIT-RECOVERY-STATUS for the same decision
creates no proposal, permit, finalized assembly, public terminal or release
does not claim that a lease is absent

inputs.meaning: Correlated CANCELLED либо TIMEOUT request, поступивший до FinalizedAnchorAssembly и ещё не разрешённый CAS относительно ASSEMBLING, LEASE_PENDING или FINALIZED
inputs.identity: workspace identity + response_assembly_id + CANCELLED|TIMEOUT + exact stage + cause
inputs.cardinality: 0..1 logical termination per response assembly; exact replay returns the same lifecycle decision
constraints: ASSEMBLING winner creates no acquire request
LEASE_PENDING records termination and waits authoritative acquire outcome
pending plus ACTIVE_ACQUIRED becomes post-permit termination for the same lease
pending plus CHANGED or FAILED creates a no-lease terminal
pending replay reads prior terminal or process-death recovery without new permit
FINALIZED is handled only by post-permit lifecycle

outputs.meaning: Закрытая платформенно нейтральная поисковая привязка с явной версией и полным selector payload к точному исходному материалу без graph node identity
outputs.identity: contract_id + contract_version + producer_id + workspace_id + contour + root_id + relative_path + полный tagged-union selector + record_id + record_content_hash + raw_source_sha256 + state_generation
outputs.units: UTF-8 strings, SHA-256 and unsigned generation
outputs.cardinality: exactly 1 provisional payload for each READY ranked position; published only through finalized OUT-SOURCE-ANCHOR-OUTCOME
outputs.creation_condition: Все обязательные per-record источники относятся к одной записи и captured generation; иначе привязка не создаётся
constraints: contract_id is exactly fastsearch.search-source-anchor and contract_version is exactly 1
producer_id is exactly fastsearch
contour is documentation or code
relative_path is normalized UTF-8 with slash separators and is never absolute

selector is a closed tagged union: markdown_heading has heading_path plus start_byte/end_byte; registry_row has positive row plus start_byte/end_byte; code_symbol has language/symbol_kind/qualified_name plus start_byte/end_byte; whole_file has no payload
every byte range is zero-based half-open over exact original bytes and satisfies 0 <= start_byte < end_byte <= raw_file_length
the internal language:kind:name:start_byte adapter string is not a wire format and must be decomposed into typed fields
selector preserves UTF-8 code points, case, whitespace and heading order exactly as admitted; no Unicode, case or whitespace renormalization is allowed in v1
missing, extra, empty or kind-incompatible selector payload is rejected as UNSUPPORTED_SOURCE_ANCHOR
record_content_hash declares its algorithm and version
raw_source_sha256 is exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters computed before BOM or newline normalization
state_generation is the authoritative generation used by the search result
absolute paths, SQLite keys, model scores and FastGraph node IDs are forbidden

outputs.meaning: Типизированный отказ создать точную привязку без ослабления происхождения
outputs.identity: error code + affected record_id + captured state_generation
outputs.cardinality: exactly 1 provisional payload for each BLOCKED ranked position; published only through finalized OUT-SOURCE-ANCHOR-OUTCOME
outputs.creation_condition: Происхождение захваченного поколения или формат отдельной записи не позволяют создать точную привязку
constraints: state_generation is always present and equals IN-SEARCH-GENERATION
record_id is present for every per-result producer failure

outputs.meaning: Внутренняя оболочка одного READY/BLOCKED payload, изолированная identity конкретной response assembly и позиции
outputs.identity: workspace identity + response_assembly_id + position_id + record_id + captured state_generation + READY(anchor) | BLOCKED(error)
outputs.cardinality: exactly 1 per completed ranked position; 0 for an empty bundle
outputs.creation_condition: Expected position produces exactly one provisional anchor or error
constraints: both and neither are forbidden
assembly, position, record and captured generation equal IN-RANKED-CANONICAL-BUNDLE
wrapper is never serialized to a public consumer

outputs.meaning: Закрытый exactly-one union результата производства привязки для одной записи и одного поколения
outputs.identity: record_id + captured state_generation + status + exactly one anchor or error payload
outputs.cardinality: exactly 1 per expected ranked position when assembly is complete and lease is ACTIVE_ACQUIRED; 0 is valid for empty success and all terminal failure branches
outputs.creation_condition: TR-FINALIZE-ANCHOR-ASSEMBLY confirms complete ordered state and ACTIVE_ACQUIRED lease; READY contains anchor only, BLOCKED contains error only
constraints: both and neither are forbidden
record_id and state_generation equal the ranked canonical input in both branches
outcome is embedded only in FinalizedAnchorAssembly and never handed directly to serializer or external consumer
success assembly, abort, failure and pre-permit termination are mutually exclusive for one response_assembly_id

outputs.meaning: Внутренний пустой снимок сборки с полным ожидаемым набором позиций до добавления provisional payload
outputs.identity: workspace identity + response_assembly_id + captured state_generation + ordered expected position_id + record_id pairs
outputs.creation_condition: INIT copies bundle identity and expected positions before any per-record work
constraints: completed provisional payload count is zero
empty ranked bundle is valid
captured generation equals IN-SEARCH-GENERATION and IN-RANKED-CANONICAL-BUNDLE

outputs.meaning: Внутренний полный снимок сборки перед запросом publication lease: ожидаемые позиции и построенные provisional payload
outputs.identity: workspace identity + response_assembly_id + captured state_generation + ordered expected position_id + record_id pairs + ordered completed provisional payload identities
outputs.cardinality: exactly 1 latest immutable state per response_assembly_id at finalization or abort decision
outputs.creation_condition: Completion transform receives initial state and exactly one provisional payload per expected position; zero provisional payloads complete an empty bundle
constraints: expected positions equal IN-RANKED-CANONICAL-BUNDLE
completed payload identities are unique by response_assembly_id + position_id + record_id + state_generation
state never invents a missing payload

outputs.meaning: Запрос generation coordinator на линейризуемую проверку captured generation и удержание writer lease до terminal commit
outputs.identity: workspace identity + response_assembly_id + captured state_generation + owner_process_identity
outputs.cardinality: exactly 1 per response_assembly_id after provisional assembly reaches a terminal decision point
outputs.creation_condition: AnchorAssemblyState exists and belongs to one ranked bundle
constraints: assembly and captured generation exactly equal OUT-ANCHOR-ASSEMBLY-STATE
owner_process_identity exactly equals IN-OWNER-PROCESS-IDENTITY
PID without process_start_time is forbidden

outputs.meaning: Начальное CAS-состояние response assembly до acquire request
outputs.creation_condition: Lifecycle is initialized from the ranked bundle
constraints: no acquire request exists
no terminal exists

outputs.meaning: CAS-состояние после единственного acquire request и до authoritative outcome
outputs.identity: workspace identity + response_assembly_id + next lifecycle_revision + LEASE_PENDING + acquire request identity
outputs.creation_condition: CAS consumes ASSEMBLING before request emission
constraints: pending termination is absent
only finalize, abort, failure or pending capture may consume this state

outputs.meaning: Отдельное CAS-состояние LEASE_PENDING с сохранённым CANCELLED либо TIMEOUT
outputs.identity: workspace identity + response_assembly_id + next lifecycle_revision + LEASE_PENDING + acquire request identity + pending termination
outputs.creation_condition: Termination CAS consumes an unmodified LEASE_PENDING state
constraints: abort, failure and ordinary finalize cannot consume this state
pending domain resolution or terminal recovery/access transition may consume it
RETRY_REQUIRED and READBACK_REQUIRED observe without consuming and preserve the exact pending event under the same acquire identity
terminal recovery/access block consumes the pending event without emitting a no-lease terminal
at most one pending event is retained

outputs.meaning: Внутреннее разрешение ThinSearchCoordinator фиксировать immutable v2 response/error под удерживаемым generation lease
outputs.identity: workspace identity + permit_id + response_assembly_id + captured state_generation + lease_id + finalized outcome count
outputs.cardinality: exactly 1 for ACTIVE_ACQUIRED complete assembly, including zero-result success; otherwise 0
outputs.creation_condition: Lease outcome is ACTIVE_ACQUIRED and state is complete
constraints: permit_id is a stable opaque derivation of contract namespace + response_assembly_id + lease_id
exact ACTIVE_ACQUIRED acquire replay recreates the same permit_id, never a new capability
lease remains held until authoritative RELEASED or exact ALREADY_RELEASED readback
outcome count equals expected positions
abort and failure are absent

outputs.meaning: Единый typed success handoff, сохраняющий assembly/position correlation, finalized outcomes и live publication permit до outer wire projection
outputs.identity: workspace identity + permit_id + response_assembly_id + captured state_generation + lease_id + ordered position_id + record_id + SearchSourceAnchorOutcome entries
outputs.cardinality: exactly 1 for ACTIVE_ACQUIRED complete assembly, including empty results; otherwise 0
outputs.creation_condition: TR-FINALIZE-ANCHOR-ASSEMBLY creates outcomes, permit and this wrapper atomically
constraints: position_id is unique and retained until outer wire projection
outcome count equals expected positions
permit assembly/generation/lease exactly match wrapper

outputs.meaning: Внутренний отказ завершить полный набор outcomes после смены поколения; per-result outcome и частичный публичный ответ не создаются
outputs.identity: workspace identity + response_assembly_id + STALE_INDEX + captured state_generation + observed state_generation
outputs.cardinality: exactly 1 when publication lease outcome is CHANGED for a response_assembly_id; otherwise 0
outputs.creation_condition: После complete assembly generation coordinator возвращает CHANGED и pending pre-permit termination отсутствует
constraints: error code is STALE_INDEX
pending pre-permit termination owns CHANGED resolution instead of abort
partial outcomes, permit and PublicSearchResponse v2 are forbidden
OUT-SOURCE-ANCHOR-OUTCOME is 0 for the same response_assembly_id

outputs.meaning: Внутренний pre-lease terminal failure generation correlation mismatch либо недоступного/повреждённого generation coordinator без частичного ответа
outputs.identity: workspace identity + response_assembly_id + SEARCH_FAILED + captured state_generation + exact stage + cause
outputs.cardinality: exactly 1 when bundle/search generation mismatch occurs before lookup or acquire outcome is FAILED; otherwise 0
outputs.creation_condition: Bundle/search generation mismatch before lookup or generation coordinator returns FAILED while pending pre-permit termination is absent
constraints: error code is SEARCH_FAILED
correlation mismatch and coordinator FAILED are mutually exclusive causes
pending pre-permit termination owns FAILED resolution instead of failure
partial outcomes, permit and public response are forbidden
no generation lease exists

outputs.meaning: Readback ранее committed terminal для exact acquire replay после release без нового permit или envelope
outputs.identity: workspace identity + response_assembly_id + lease_id + committed_terminal_identity + terminal_journal_ref + terminal_record_digest + released_revision
outputs.creation_condition: Coordinator returns exact retained terminal replay for the acquire identity
constraints: new FinalizedAnchorAssembly is forbidden
application::public_search creates no new public envelope or release identity

when released_revision exists but the response outbox still proves RELEASE_PENDING|RECOVERY_REQUIRED, downstream thin_search may retransmit only the original same-key logical release to obtain ALREADY_RELEASED and durably close that outbox
terminal_journal_ref and terminal_record_digest address one immutable authoritative terminal record
thin_search must read back and verify that record before replay delivery or closure continuation
generation coordinator retains the replay pointer no longer than the response lifecycle outbox retains the addressed terminal

outputs.meaning: Recovery-only исход exact acquire replay после PROCESS_DIED без действующего permit
outputs.identity: workspace identity + response_assembly_id + lease_id + owner_process_identity + cleanup_revision + PROCESS_DIED
outputs.creation_condition: Coordinator returns exact tagged process-death replay
constraints: no publication permit exists
no public envelope or new release is created
caller must start a new search if still needed

outputs.meaning: Correlated CANCELLED либо TIMEOUT, которое завершило anchor assembly без generation lease
outputs.identity: workspace identity + response_assembly_id + CANCELLED|TIMEOUT + lifecycle_phase + exact stage + cause
outputs.cardinality: exactly 1 when termination wins before acquire request or LEASE_PENDING resolves CHANGED|FAILED; otherwise 0
outputs.creation_condition: Lifecycle CAS proves that no ACTIVE_ACQUIRED lease or FinalizedAnchorAssembly exists
constraints: provisional payload is discarded
acquire request is absent or authoritative non-ACTIVE_ACQUIRED
no release request is allowed because no lease exists
CANCELLED suppresses public envelope
TIMEOUT permits one public TIMEOUT error

outputs.meaning: Pending CANCELLED либо TIMEOUT, машинно коррелированный с ACTIVE_ACQUIRED lease для post-permit terminal lifecycle
outputs.identity: workspace identity + permit_id + response_assembly_id + lease_id + CANCELLED|TIMEOUT + exact stage + cause
outputs.cardinality: exactly 1 when a pending termination meets exact ACTIVE_ACQUIRED outcome; otherwise 0
outputs.creation_condition: One lifecycle CAS correlates pending response_assembly_id with the lease_id returned by ACTIVE_ACQUIRED
constraints: FinalizedAnchorAssembly for the same permit and lease exists
permit_id, response_assembly_id and lease_id are copied in the same lifecycle CAS
event enters post-permit terminal CAS
pre-permit termination, abort and failure are absent

outputs.meaning: Наблюдаемый control state response assembly, ожидающего или исчерпавшего recovery записи ACQUIRE
outputs.identity: workspace identity + response_assembly_id + captured_generation + owner_process_identity + acquire operation identity + optional proposal revision/digest + RETRY_REQUIRED|READBACK_REQUIRED|RECOVERY_BLOCKED + optional lookup attempt/deadline + exact evidence
outputs.cardinality: 0..1 current state per response assembly; exactly 1 for a current acquire commit-recovery status or state-access block
outputs.creation_condition: Acquire coordinator emitted commit-recovery status or state-access block instead of a domain outcome
constraints: RETRY_REQUIRED and READBACK_REQUIRED preserve LEASE_PENDING and provisional payload
RECOVERY_BLOCKED moves only this assembly to an operation-level blocked state
never emits FinalizedAnchorAssembly, permit, public envelope, public terminal or release
blocked acquire does not claim that a lease is absent

transformations.rule: Для ожидаемой position_id атомарно получить provenance по record_id + captured state_generation, сверить locator/selector и root, затем создать anchor и READY provisional wrapper с точными response_assembly_id + position_id; последующий выбор не повторяет lookup
transformations.loss_justification: Эти поля не участвуют в независимом допуске и raw-byte разрешении источника; логический корень, точный локатор, record content hash, raw source hash и поколение сохраняются

transformations.rule: Для ожидаемой position_id отклонить отсутствие или расхождение typed root/locator/full-selector/raw hash, неизвестный selector/version или абсолютный путь; создать error и BLOCKED provisional wrapper с теми же response_assembly_id + position_id + record_id + generation

Только если IN-SEARCH-GENERATION точно равен bundle captured generation, создать пустой initial state и lifecycle ASSEMBLING revision 1 с expected positions; для нулевой выдачи он допускает немедленное completion
До INIT, provenance lookup и lease request отклонить несовпадение captured generation как один SEARCH_FAILED / ASSEMBLY_CORRELATION_FAILED без provisional state
lost_data: ranked display fields and ordered positions
transformations.loss_justification: Несогласованный внутренний bundle нельзя безопасно использовать; публичный partial result запрещён, exact mismatch сохраняется во внутренней диагностике

transformations.rule: Собрать ровно один provisional payload на каждую expected position по response_assembly_id + position_id + record_id + captured generation; для empty bundle собрать zero payloads; выпустить один complete state без path/rank correlation
CAS ASSEMBLING -> LEASE_PENDING; скопировать response_assembly_id, captured generation и exact PID + process_start_time в один lease request без чтения current generation внутри public_search

Единым lifecycle CAS при ACTIVE_ACQUIRED и полном state перейти LEASE_PENDING -> FINALIZED, выпустить ordered mapping и стабильный opaque permit_id, однозначно производный от contract namespace + response_assembly_id + lease_id; exact active acquire replay даёт тот же permit; FinalizedAnchorAssembly несёт тот же permit/assembly/generation/lease; pending termination разрешается только TR-RESOLVE, empty state даёт empty mapping plus permit
lost_data: mutable accumulator representation and provisional completion flags
transformations.loss_justification: FinalizedAnchorAssembly сохраняет response assembly, ordered position identity, outcomes и active lease permit; теряется только более не нужное изменяемое состояние накопителя

transformations.rule: Единым lifecycle CAS только из LEASE_PENDING без pending termination при CHANGED перейти в TERMINAL и выпустить один abort; прекратить сборку и удалить provisional payload; другие terminal outputs недостижимы
lost_data: all completed provisional SearchSourceAnchor and SearchSourceAnchorError payloads
transformations.loss_justification: Атомарный внешний ответ не может содержать данные разных поколений; provisional payload не являются публичными и намеренно уничтожаются вместо частичной публикации

transformations.rule: Единым lifecycle CAS только из LEASE_PENDING без pending termination при coordinator FAILED перейти в TERMINAL, выпустить один SEARCH_FAILED, удалить provisional payload и не создавать permit/outcomes
lost_data: ordered expected position set not needed for safe public error
transformations.loss_justification: Недостоверный coordinator outcome запрещает публикацию результата; наружу сохраняются assembly, captured generation и точная диагностическая причина, но не partial response

transformations.rule: Единым CAS только для REPLAYED_TERMINAL завершить текущую duplicate assembly authoritative readback старым terminal identity и exact terminal_journal_ref + terminal_record_digest + released_revision; application::public_search не создаёт permit, FinalizedAnchorAssembly, envelope или новую release identity; thin_search после authoritative outbox readback может продолжить только исходный same-key release для durable closure
Единым CAS только для REPLAYED_PROCESS_DIED завершить duplicate assembly recovery-only исходом без permit/envelope/release и потребовать новый search intent
CAS по exact response_assembly_id: ASSEMBLING -> TERMINAL выпускает no-lease termination; LEASE_PENDING -> LEASE_PENDING записывает pending termination без terminal output; FINALIZED не потреблять
lost_data: all provisional anchor payloads and ordered display fields for the terminated assembly
transformations.loss_justification: До внешнего terminal provisional state не является публичным; cancellation не создаёт envelope, timeout создаёт только безопасную public error без partial results

transformations.rule: Только при отсутствии OUT-ANCHOR-LIFECYCLE-PENDING-TERMINATION для exact unmodified LEASE_PENDING применить ACQUIRE status: сохранить исходную operation/proposal identity; NOT_COMMITTED_RETRY либо COMMIT_READBACK_REQUIRED оставляет assembly в LEASE_PENDING без нового request identity; COMMIT_RECOVERY_BLOCKED переводит только assembly в RECOVERY_BLOCKED, не доказывает отсутствие lease и не создаёт domain outcome, permit, public terminal или release
lost_data: provisional payload only after terminal RECOVERY_BLOCKED
transformations.loss_justification: После исчерпания recovery assembly не может быть опубликована, но потенциально записанный lease запрещает выдавать безопасный no-lease terminal

transformations.rule: Только при отсутствии OUT-ANCHOR-LIFECYCLE-PENDING-TERMINATION для exact unmodified LEASE_PENDING применить ACQUIRE access block: сохранить operation, lookup evidence и optional retained proposal identity byte-for-byte; перевести только эту assembly в RECOVERY_BLOCKED, уничтожить provisional payload и не создавать domain outcome, permit, public terminal, release либо новый acquire identity
transformations.loss_justification: Недоступный authoritative ledger не позволяет публиковать assembly и не доказывает отсутствие потенциального lease

transformations.rule: Для exact pending CANCELLED|TIMEOUT и той же ACQUIRE operation/proposal identity: NOT_COMMITTED_RETRY|COMMIT_READBACK_REQUIRED наблюдает pending state без потребления, сохраняет тот же event в LEASE_PENDING и выпускает recovery state без нового acquire; COMMIT_RECOVERY_BLOCKED потребляет pending state, переводит assembly в RECOVERY_BLOCKED и не создаёт no-lease terminal, permit или release
lost_data: provisional payload and pending CANCELLED|TIMEOUT only after terminal COMMIT_RECOVERY_BLOCKED
transformations.loss_justification: При terminal commit ambiguity потенциально записанный lease запрещает выдавать pending event как доказанно no-lease terminal; для RETRY_REQUIRED|READBACK_REQUIRED данные сохраняются полностью

transformations.rule: Для exact pending CANCELLED|TIMEOUT и той же ACQUIRE access-block identity потребить pending state, сохранить workspace/operation/lookup/optional proposal evidence byte-for-byte и перевести assembly в RECOVERY_BLOCKED без no-lease terminal, permit, release либо нового acquire
lost_data: provisional payload and pending CANCELLED|TIMEOUT after terminal state-access block
transformations.loss_justification: Недоступный authoritative ledger не доказывает отсутствие потенциального lease, поэтому pending event не может стать безопасным public terminal

transformations.rule: Единым CAS из LEASE_PENDING с pending termination: CHANGED или FAILED -> один no-lease termination; ACTIVE_ACQUIRED -> FinalizedAnchorAssembly, стабильный permit_id и correlated post-permit event с exact permit_id + response_assembly_id + lease_id; REPLAYED_TERMINAL -> prior terminal readback; REPLAYED_PROCESS_DIED -> recovery-only outcome; ветви не создаются совместно
lost_data: all provisional anchor payloads and ordered display fields only when outcome is CHANGED or FAILED
transformations.loss_justification: Pending cancellation/timeout уже владеет assembly terminal; authoritative non-ACTIVE_ACQUIRED доказывает отсутствие lease и разрешает безопасно уничтожить provisional state

handoffs.surface: GenerationPublicationLeaseRequest v1 + exactly one of GenerationPublicationLeaseOutcome v1 | GenerationLeaseCommitRecoveryStatus v1 | GenerationLeaseStateAccessBlocked v1
preconditions: one ranked bundle and assembly state exist
request copies assembly, captured generation and exact owner PID plus process start time
consumer_obligations: apply BC-FS-GENERATION-PUBLICATION-LEASE acquire semantics
return exactly one correlated domain outcome XOR GenerationLeaseCommitRecoveryStatus XOR GenerationLeaseStateAccessBlocked
preserve workspace, operation, lookup and optional retained proposal evidence in access block
never invent observed generation on FAILED
route unresolved commit status through the runtime supervisor without changing operation identity
route terminal access block to application::public_search, thin_search, request owner and diagnostics without a new acquire identity
handoffs.success: Authoritative coordinator receives the exact correlation identity it attests
acceptance_refs: DT13-A generation lease coordinator three-way outcome oracle

preconditions: acquire domain outcome is absent and exact commit-recovery status or state-access block exists for the same coordinator decision
consumer_obligations: wait without public envelope for RETRY_REQUIRED or READBACK_REQUIRED
on RECOVERY_BLOCKED end the request as an operation-level block, not PublicSearchError v2 or PublicResponseAssemblyTerminal
never infer lease absence
handoffs.success: Resolved exact acquire later returns through the ordinary lease domain-outcome path
acceptance_refs: DT13-A acquire NOT_COMMITTED, UNKNOWN-to-resolution, UNKNOWN-to-block, ledger-access-block and pending CANCELLED|TIMEOUT recovery fixtures

preconditions: same acquire operation identity is retained
consumer_obligations: schedule only bounded same-operation lookup/readback for RETRY_REQUIRED or READBACK_REQUIRED
for RECOVERY_BLOCKED preserve the terminal stop without a new retry identity
never start a new acquire identity
preserve terminal block evidence
handoffs.success: Commit ambiguity resolves or reaches one explicit operation-level block

preconditions: assembly state is complete, including empty bundle
consumer_obligations: consume permit once into response, safe error or suppressed terminal
send one logical idempotent release identity after terminal
retry/read back until authoritative CLOSED
never publish provisional wrapper fields
handoffs.success: Sole outer producer receives complete outcomes and a live publication permit
acceptance_refs: DT13-A zero-result, consume-once terminal, active A+B leases, lost ACK, retry/readback and process-crash fixtures

preconditions: generation coordinator observed generation differs from captured, including a change before or after provisional completion
consumer_obligations: suppress partial outcomes and PublicSearchResponse v2
produce one outer PublicSearchError v2 with STALE_INDEX
do not downgrade to per-result BLOCKED
handoffs.success: Late generation change is machine-reachable to the sole producer of the external response
acceptance_refs: DT13-A late G1 to G2 generation fixture

preconditions: bundle/search generation mismatch before lookup or coordinator returned correlated FAILED
consumer_obligations: suppress partial outcomes and response
produce one outer SEARCH_FAILED
retain exact internal stage/cause for diagnostics
handoffs.success: Correlation/coordinator failure reaches the sole outer producer as one terminal branch
acceptance_refs: DT13-A generation mismatch and coordinator unavailable/corrupt fixtures

preconditions: lifecycle CAS proved that no ACTIVE_ACQUIRED lease exists
consumer_obligations: commit TIMEOUT as one public error
commit CANCELLED as suppressed no-envelope terminal
never create release request without lease_id
handoffs.success: Early termination reaches the sole outer producer without provisional leak or orphan lease
acceptance_refs: DT13-A ASSEMBLING and LEASE_PENDING cancellation/timeout fixtures

consumer_obligations: read back the immutable terminal by exact terminal_journal_ref
verify terminal_record_digest and committed_terminal_identity before delivery
preserve the original response or error bytes, including SUPPRESSED outcome
surface typed lifecycle corruption instead of synthesizing a terminal when readback is absent or mismatched
do not create a second envelope, FinalizedAnchorAssembly or new release identity

if released_revision is authoritative while response outbox is still RELEASE_PENDING|RECOVERY_REQUIRED, create only a replay continuation of the original same-key release until exact ALREADY_RELEASED closes the outbox
handoffs.success: Duplicate acquire after terminal release remains observationally idempotent
failures: missing prior terminal is a typed lifecycle corruption
acceptance_refs: DT13-A duplicate acquire after release and after generation advance fixture

consumer_obligations: return recovery-only internal outcome
start a new search for new user intent
never synthesize public success
handoffs.success: Dead-owner replay cannot resurrect a lease
acceptance_refs: DT13-A acquire replay after process cleanup fixture

preconditions: pending termination and ACTIVE_ACQUIRED outcome share exact response_assembly_id
event and FinalizedAnchorAssembly contain the same permit_id, response_assembly_id and lease_id
consumer_obligations: correlate all three identity fields before applying the post-permit terminal CAS
release the exact lease after terminal
never reinterpret it as no-lease termination
handoffs.success: Pending termination reaches a machine-visible post-permit branch without orphaning the acquired lease
failures: correlation mismatch enters typed lifecycle recovery
acceptance_refs: DT13-A pending plus ACTIVE_ACQUIRED transition fixture

integration_decision.reason: Производящий формат можно согласовать сейчас, но реальная интеграция требует атомарного typed-root/locator/raw-hash lineage, публичной схемы, выпускаемого клиента и канонической потребляющей пары FastGraph

integration_tests.path: DT13-B planned FastSearch -> client -> FastGraph acceptance

blockers.resolution_condition: MCP и JSON передают одинаковый immutable envelope; lease удерживается до terminal commit и освобождается один раз; выбор не повторяет lookup

blockers.unknown: Не реализован атомарный lookup record_id + state_generation -> contour + root_id + locator + raw_source_sha256; CanonicalRecord не содержит типизированный root, а текущий SourceSnapshot file_hash вычисляется после нормализации

blockers.resolution_condition: Независимый потребитель различает payload всех вариантов селектора и отклоняет неизвестные или лишние поля, версии, абсолютные пути и неверные хэши по принятой политике совместимости
